Well my dear Catalyst reviewers, our long road has come to an end. I would like to say that this has been a good experience the last many months working on this with both of you. I have appreciated your professionalism and understanding. 
As always, I have complied our support into this single document so it is easy to review. The link for it is provided here: 
https://docs.google.com/document/d/1j3z9-aQFIxJknS3M5b30lvpOusSuWAvqACtGYHmlUaA/edit?usp=sharing

Then, as this is our final milestone, I have also complied the close out report for you which you can find here:
https://docs.google.com/document/d/16BtxMHsveR3yayANL89lSATagU0PYrWuXmtGMXpaYZM/edit?usp=sharing

The close our video is included in the report, but for ease of reviewer, here it is again:
https://youtu.be/KzXQ4KAXBh0

If you have any questions or concerns with any of the support provided, please let me know and I will get it resolved quickly.
